name: thunder_zone_gate_east
notes: Author's two WE_OBJECTS_V1 pastes (10 + 2 records, both found exactly on metin2_map_mt_thunder; they are every record within 34 m of the gate at (644, 1450)). An ENTRANCE FROM ANOTHER ZONE, FRONTS EAST (facing 90; the block is at roll 285/105, so it looks 15 deg south of east). A roofed stone door (general_obj_stonedoor) across a road in a gully between two rock masses, the warpgate02 portal effect 2 m in front of it, a fortMS fence pillar and panel closing the gap to each cliff, a stone lion either side of the approach 5 m out, a tree (Pagoda1 / Pagoda3, the catalog names of two broadleaf trees) behind each end -- and 30 m out along the approach a PAIR OF STONE LIGHTS (b1_018-stonelight) 25.7 m apart, one either side of the road, like gateposts. A LANDFORM pattern (relief radius 64 m, feather 12, base read AT THE PIVOT -- the ring is cliff; source collision inside r 52; the field01/field04 road paint inside r 50) because the terrain is the trick: BEHIND the door the road does not stop. It runs on, painted and BLOCKED, 25 m west and then bends south-west behind a rock shoulder and away to the map edge 85 m off -- so a player looking through the door sees a road curving out of sight behind rock, never the void at the edge of the map. The author: entrances are angular so players do not see the void. Every tile west of the door is blocked; the door is the end of the walkable road. rotate_deg = (90 - B) mod 360. Put it where a road meets the map's border ridge.
